result.title: Computer Vision and Knowledge-Grounded Language Models for Intelligent Beekeeper Assistance
result.summary: Managed and wild bees sustain roughly a third of the global food products, yet colonies face mounting stress from climate-change including extreme weather patterns, altered parasite and disease patterns. Timely assessment of colony condition such as understanding colony strength, brood area, honey and pollen storage, comb usage, is essential to adaptive management. However, manual hive frame inspection is slow, costly, and quality depends on scarce expertise. We present an artificial targeted intelligent system framework focusing on edge deployable pipeline that turns hive frame photographs into interpretable and action-oriented inspection report. The pipeline includes an object detector to detect biologically-meaningful comb-cell classes; detections are distilled into structured fact schema; facts are converted into constrained factual text; the text triggers a grounded knowledge-base for interpretations and recommendations. Knowledge-base entries are required to be triggerable by evidence expressed in the fact schema. We built our system based on open source FAIRHiveFrames-1K dataset and favour reproducible, edge-deployable models over large general purpose frontier models. We additionally release FAIRHiveText-1K dataset that turns FAIRHiveFrames-1K dataset into interchangeable facts and text interpretation of the facts, making it easy for further LLM-based research into this area. We also propose a pathway to develop the grounded knowledge-base that will be helpful in providing interpretable and actionable reports from the facts.

AI.brief_summary: 该文构建面向养蜂的端侧可部署系统，把蜂巢脾照片经目标检测转成结构化事实，再生成受约束的描述文本，并用可被事实触发的知识库产出可解释的巡检建议，同时发布事实—文本配对数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「视觉检测→结构化事实→文本→证据可触发的知识库」链条，可供核查视觉证据如何被压缩成可验证事实、以及答案是否真的依赖这些证据，与 LVR 的视觉信息保留和证据筛选问题有潜在联系，但任务域较远。
